The *Ekadussadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 336) is a biographical verse text preserved in the Therāpadāna section of the Pali Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral lists five translations of the text across five languages [SuttaCentral].

DharmaNexus identifies extensive Pali-internal text reuse, recording 153 matching passages across 25 Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. Most prominently, it exhibits near-verbatim duplication with a homonymous poem in the collection, the second *Ekadussadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 424), covering almost the entire text (§0.2–18.1 matching §0.2–19.1 with 0.98 similarity) [DharmaNexus]. Substantial segments are also shared with the commentary on the *Theragāthā* (*Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā*) as well as related monastic narratives in the Therāpadāna, such as the *Ekāsanadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 425) and *Ñāṇathavikattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 486) [DharmaNexus].
